C1.rationale: Nearly every hard constraint concerns irreversibility (lost work, duplicate PRs, a bare-flipped shared checkout) and states the causal mechanism, so the model can generalise past the enumerated cases; softer matters (concurrency, wave sizing, read budgets) are framed as defaults and preferences rather than prohibitions.

C2.rationale: The contract this unit defines is interface-shaped rather than example-taught: outcomes are a named enumeration (`status: success|partial|failed`) declared alongside what each must return, and the agentType and resume tables enumerate alternatives with the invalid combination named outright; it stops short of 5 because the authoritative Return Contract field list lives in REFERENCE.md rather than at the point of declaration.

evidence.quote: | **Success** | PR URL **plus one summary metric** (test/line delta) — `status: success` |

C3.rationale: The entry point carries the core dispatch path and defers schemas, templates, salvage routines and evidence trails to a supporting file referenced by name with section anchors — competent disclosure — but it is single-level into one large sidecar, and several genuinely rare paths (nested-repo isolation, GIT_DIR export leak, cwd-reset, rate-limit recovery) are still inlined in the entry point rather than split into separately-loadable files.

C4.rationale: Ownership boundaries are stated explicitly against every sibling (agent-teams owns team mechanics, exclusive-lock-dispatch owns lock waves, REFERENCE.md owns schemas/templates) and the siblings reciprocate by pointing back rather than restating; one real duplication remains — the resumeFromRunId hazard is maintained here in full and again in the always-loaded `.claude/rules/agent-coworker-detection.md` (§ "`Workflow` resume re-runs already-succeeded worktree agents"), same #1858/#1857 evidence, so the copy is paid for on every turn.

C5.rationale: C5 applies only to always-loaded surfaces (CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/*). This is a SKILL.md body that costs tokens only once the skill fires.

C6.rationale: Mechanical verification is delegated to named executable artifacts rather than described in prose — a bulk-edit-to-checker table, the authoritative re-run (knip/build/test) after a completion manifest, and copy-verbatim schemas — and the unit is explicit about which mode applies: run the script and read its exit code, versus copy the schema text into the brief.
